ce_bugs.text: Stored XSS: unsanitized raw RSS/Atom content is stored as raw_html and cooked without sanitization, allowing <script>/<iframe>/onerror injection from attacker-controlled feeds
Unescaped URL interpolated into HTML attribute and body in TopicEmbed footer, allowing script injection via crafted embed URLs
Infinite 30-second reload loop on embed loading page with silently swallowed retrieval failures, causing unbounded job/request amplification and no error surfaced to user
Non-atomic setnx/expire in TopicRetriever can leave a Redis key with no TTL, permanently wedging the retrieval throttle for an embed URL
Update path crashes with NoMethodError when the embedded post has been deleted, since embed.post is used without a presence check
CGI.unescapeHTML double-decodes feed content before import, corrupting legitimate escaped entities and converting escaped HTML into live executable tags

retrieved_recently? uses non-atomic SETNX followed by EXPIRE, so if the process dies between the two calls the Redis throttle key persists without a TTL, permanently blocking auto-retrieval for that URL and leaking keys without bound; should use a single atomic SET key val EX 60 NX
import_remote and feed polling use open(url).read to download the entire remote response into memory with no size cap, which can balloon worker memory on large or misbehaving remote resources

disqus:import task behavior changed to fetch live content via TopicEmbed.import_remote instead of importing from the export file, silently changing behavior and losing created_at preservation; dead links silently skip threads

Imported raw HTML bypasses sanitization/cooking pipeline: Post#cook returns raw verbatim for cook_method == raw_html and TopicEmbed.import stores content as-is with skip_validations, creating a stored XSS surface via the embed view's '<%= raw post.cooked %>'
PollFeed import path passes CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) with no tag/attribute filtering, and unescaping HTML converts safely-escaped entities in the source feed into live markup
Readability import path whitelists tags but not href attribute values, allowing javascript: URLs
Unsanitized third-party HTML rendered raw (raw_html cook method and '<raw post.cooked>' in embed view) allows XSS via feed/embed content
PollFeed#poll_feed crashes on feed items with nil content because nil.scrub raises NoMethodError, aborting the entire poll mid-loop
String#scrub in PollFeed is not available on Ruby < 2.1, raising unconditionally on older runtimes
Non-atomic SETNX + EXPIRE throttle key in TopicRetriever can leave the key without a TTL if the process dies between calls, permanently throttling that embed URL
postMessage origin check in embed.js uses substring matching (indexOf) instead of equality, allowing forged messages from prefix origins
TopicRetriever#perform_retrieve polls the entire feed synchronously inside a background job for every unmatched embed URL, causing duplicate import work and RecordNotUnique job failures
Resize postMessage in embed layout breaks when request.referer is absent, rendering an empty targetOrigin and throwing so the iframe never resizes
Concurrent import race on embed_url check-then-insert causes RecordNotUnique job failures instead of being handled as expected deduplication

No coverage that imported raw HTML content is sanitized — TopicEmbed.import stores feed HTML with cook_method: raw_html, bypassing sanitization, and the embed view renders it with raw post.cooked, creating an untested stored-XSS path

EmbedController#best success tests verify mock wiring instead of behavior: the test expects TopicRetriever.new(...).retrieve while the controller enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) and never asserts the job payload; TopicView is fully mocked so real view rendering (avatars, post.cooked, post limit, header/footer logic) is unexercised

Disqus importer behavior change with no test: import path rewritten from locally-created permalink post to TopicEmbed.import_remote performing HTTP fetches, and the --category CLI option silently removed, breaking users who relied on it

Stored XSS: TopicEmbed.import passes arbitrary feed HTML through with cook_method: raw_html, bypassing sanitization, and the embed view renders it with raw post.cooked, allowing malicious script tags/event handlers from the feed to be stored and served to all visitors
TopicEmbed.import mutates caller's contents string in place (contents << "\n<hr>..."), causing surprising behavior with frozen or reused strings
force: true added to pre-existing migration create_top_topics.rb, which will silently drop an existing top_topics table in replay/restore scenarios (data-loss footgun)

Raw HTML import path bypasses the sanitization/cooking pipeline: cook_method == raw_html returns raw content verbatim, which is rendered with raw post.cooked in the embed view, allowing onerror/onclick handlers and javascript: hrefs from external RSS/Readability content to execute as stored XSS
Readability's tag filtering is not sanitization: it does not strip attribute content like event handlers or javascript: URIs, so malicious attributes survive into rendered embeds
PollFeed job crashes with NoMethodError on feed items lacking content (CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) when content is nil)
Redis throttle in TopicRetriever uses non-atomic setnx followed by expire; if the process dies between calls the key persists forever without TTL, permanently blocking retrieval for that embed URL

Origin check in embed.js uses substring match (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin) === -1) instead of exact equality, allowing lookalike origins like https://evil.co to pass when discourseUrl is https://evil.com

Post#cook returns raw verbatim when cook_method == raw_html, allowing unsanitized third-party RSS content from PollFeed to be stored in posts.cooked and rendered with raw, causing stored XSS on the forum origin
Unescaped request.referer interpolated into single-quoted inline JS in embed.html.erb postMessage call, allowing script injection on the forum origin via a crafted referer URL
Unescaped URL interpolated into the imported_from anchor HTML in TopicEmbed.imported_from, allowing HTML attribute/event injection since URL is only validated with a basic https?:// prefix check
Non-atomic SETNX followed by EXPIRE in TopicRetriever: a crash between the two calls leaves the key with no TTL, permanently blocking retrieval of that embed URL

PollFeed lacks per-item error handling: one malformed feed item (missing content, nil title, or duplicate embed_url race) raises an unrescued exception that aborts the entire run with retry: false, silently skipping all subsequent items
Loading view reloads every 30 seconds forever on unrecoverable retrieval failure, causing unbounded request/job churn per visitor with no backoff or terminal state

mrv_findings.text: poll_feed.rb:30 uses String#scrub which requires Ruby 2.1, but the repo targets Ruby 2.0, causing NoMethodError on every PollFeed execution

poll_feed.rb:30 calls i.content.scrub without a nil guard; many RSS feeds expose content as content_encoded or only description, so i.content is nil and a single content-less item aborts the entire polling run mid-way

embed_controller.rb:15 uses params.require, a Rails 4 strong-parameters API, but the repo's default Rails 3 bundle has no require method, so every request to embed/best fails with NoMethodError instead of the intended 404

New gems ruby-readability, guess_html_encoding, and simple-rss are added only to Gemfile_rails4.lock and not to the parallel Rails 3 lockfile, causing dependency resolution failures and LoadError on the Rails 3 bundle

New top-level assets embed.js and embed.css are never registered in config.assets.precompile, so rake assets:precompile in production omits them and the embed feature 404s on the deployment path it targets

Migration 20131223171005_create_top_topics.rb is edited in place to add force: true; the edit is a no-op for databases that already ran it, and re-execution would silently drop and recreate top_topics, discarding computed topic stats

No HTML sanitization in the PollFeed import pipeline: unescaped feed HTML passes directly to TopicEmbed.import with raw_html cook method, bypassing the sanitization pipeline, and is rendered via `<%= raw post.cooked %>` — allows script injection/XSS in feed content (Confidence 75, P1)

poll_feed.rb: `i.content` is assumed to exist on every feed item; RSS/Atom items with only `<description>` have nil content and `nil.scrub` raises NoMethodError, aborting the entire hourly poll mid-run with retry: false so the failure is silent (Confidence 75, P2)

embed/loading.html.erb: no failure/terminal state for the embed — if retrieval silently fails (invalid host, recently retrieved, unresolvable username, Sidekiq fetch failure), the loading page reloads every 30 seconds forever with no signal to the consumer (Confidence 75, P2)

poll_feed.rb: `feed_key` (Last-Modified/conditional-GET tracking) is defined but never called — dead code from an unfinished conditional-poll optimization, causing full feed fetch and re-parse every hour (Confidence 100, P3)

lib/topic_retriever.rb: retrieval throttle uses non-atomic separate SETNX and EXPIRE commands — if the process dies between them, the key exists without TTL and that embed URL is throttled forever with no recovery path; should be SET key val NX EX 60 (Confidence 50, P2)

Only Gemfile_rails4.lock was updated for the new ruby-readability and simple-rss gems; the primary Gemfile.lock is stale, breaking non-Rails4 builds, especially under --frozen deployment pinning (Confidence 50, P2)

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb: no tests exercise the actual feed-parsing path — all tests stub poll_feed itself, so real RSS/Atom XML is never run through SimpleRSS.parse → TopicEmbed.import, leaving the 'RSS and Atom feeds both import correctly' criterion unverified (Confidence 75, P2)

embed.js: no guard for a missing `#discourse-comments` element — `comments.appendChild(iframe)` throws TypeError on mis-installed pages, silently killing embedding with only a console error (Confidence 50, P3)

No sanitization on the imported-HTML path: Post#cook short-circuits for raw_html cook_method, TopicEmbed.import stores feed content verbatim with skip_validations, and best.html.erb renders it with raw, so untrusted feed HTML (including PollFeed content that bypasses readability's whitelist) can inject scripts into the embedding site

TopicEmbed.import unescapes/unescaped interpolation of a remote URL into stored HTML: the 'imported_from' link builds an anchor from url with only a /^https?/ check, allowing injection of markup like '><script> via crafted embed URLs
Disqus importer regression: removal of --category option and original timestamps (created_at: Date.parse) means imported threads lose their real creation dates and category placement

PollFeed job crashes on feeds without a content field: CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError for RSS 2.0 description-only or Atom summary-only feeds, and with retry: false one bad item aborts the entire poll so later items are never imported

Dead code in PollFeed: feed_key is defined but never used, so the intended 'only re-import when the feed changed' logic was never implemented, causing hourly re-parsing and full PostRevisor revisions of changed items

TopicRetriever.perform_retrieve synchronously executes the entire scheduled PollFeed job inline during embed URL retrieval, doubling feed-poll load, adding full feed latency to the retrieval path, and failing the user's retrieval if the feed errors

Untraceable edits to already-shipped migrations: adding force: true to create_table :top_topics is destructive (drops/recreates the table on re-run, discarding ranking data), and migrate_word_counts gets whitespace-only churn
Dangling admin menu entry: client.en.yml adds an 'Embedding' admin menu string but the diff contains no corresponding admin view, route, or controller

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29-34: No error isolation around the per-item import loop; i.content can be nil for Atom feeds (which use description/summary), causing NoMethodError that aborts the entire rss.items.each iteration
app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb: With sidekiq_options retry: false, a single malformed feed entry permanently kills feed importing with zero error surfacing until the article ages out of the feed

lib/topic_retriever.rb:29-34: retrieved_recently? uses non-atomic $redis.setnx followed by a separate $redis.expire; if the process dies between them the key persists with no TTL and retrieval is permanently blocked until the key is manually deleted; should use SET key val EX 60 NX (or MULTI)
lib/topic_retriever.rb: The 60s throttle is set before retrieval succeeds, so a failed fetch (network error, 404) still consumes the throttle window for all users

app/models/topic_embed.rb:24,78: embed_url is stored and matched raw with no normalization (scheme, trailing slash, query/UTM params, case); URL variants like http vs https or with utm_source params create duplicate topics for the same article since exact string equality/unique index don't catch them

db/migrate/20131217174004_create_topic_embeds.rb:5-6 + app/models/topic_embed.rb:28-32: topic_id/post_id are null: false but have no foreign key and no dependent cleanup, allowing dangling topic_embeds rows when an imported post/topic is hard-destroyed; schema should enforce this with FK ON DELETE CASCADE
app/models/topic_embed.rb:28-32: When embed.post is nil from a dangling row, PostRevisor.new(nil) raises and, due to missing error isolation, the entire hourly poll dies at that item every hour

app/models/topic_embed.rb:32-33: content_sha1 is updated unconditionally and outside a transaction even when revisor.revise! returns false or partially fails, so the hash drifts from actual post content and the 'update only if changed' guard enforces a weaker invariant than intended

app/controllers/embed_controller.rb:14 + app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:6-10: Loading view reloads every 30s with no terminal state and each reload re-enqueues Jobs.enqueue(:retrieve_topic, ...) for embeds that will never appear, generating a Sidekiq job per visitor every 30 seconds indefinitely with no cap, backoff, or dead-end message

app/models/topic_embed.rb:49-52 + app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:27: Outbound fetches via open(url).read have no open timeout (open-uri default open_timeout is nil) and no size cap, so a wedged remote site can hang a Sidekiq job indefinitely and a large response is fully materialized in memory
lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117,143-145: Unversioned breaking change removes the --category/-c option from the disqus import contract, breaking existing scripted invocations with 'Unknown option' errors

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:143-145: The new import path makes one dead link (open(t[:link]) raising) abort the entire import loop with no rescue, dropping every thread after the failing one and leaving already-created topics half-populated with replies silently skipped

config/site_settings.yml:353-357: Architecture hardwires 'exactly one embeddable host and one polled feed' into global settings while the topic_embeds table is per-URL/per-host; supporting a second site forces schema/settings migration, and all three enforcement points (EmbedController, TopicRetriever, PollFeed) must change in lockstep

lib/tasks/disqus.thor:117-149: The --category/-c option is deleted and import logic replaced with TopicEmbed.import_remote, silently breaking existing automation invoking 'thor disqus:import -c' with unrecognized-option errors and changing output from local permalink posts to network fetches dependent on remote site availability

db/migrate/20131223171005:4: Adding force: true to the pre-existing create_table :top_topics migration will drop and recreate the table on re-run (rollback/re-migrate), destroying accumulated top-topic statistics

db/migrate/20131210181901_migrate_word_counts.rb: Whitespace-only churn (trailing space and EOF newline changes) to an already-shipped migration, indicating unreviewed mutations outside the stated scope

app/models/post.rb:131-135: Validation is inverted — the cooking pipeline (including sanitization) is bypassed for embed-imported posts (raw_html cook method returns raw unfiltered), and embed/best.html.erb renders it with raw post.cooked, so third-party HTML from poll_feed.rb and TopicEmbed.import (with skip_validations: true) can inject script tags, event handlers, or javascript: hrefs, causing persistent XSS

app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:19: The origin check uses substring matching (discourseUrl.indexOf(e.origin)), so an origin like 'http://eviltrout.com.evil.net' passes a discourseUrl of 'http://eviltrout.com', allowing a hostile framing page to spoof discourse-resize messages and inject arbitrary iframe heights (layout-spoofing/clickjacking surface)

app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:31-34: The code assumes every feed item has a 'content' field; the first item without a <content> element (common in Atom feeds with only <summary>) raises NoMethodError, killing the hourly poll and all embedding for that site despite the advertised RSS/ATOM support
poll_feed.rb: String#scrub requires Ruby >= 2.1 but the codebase still targets Ruby 1.9 per the Gemfile comment

lib/post_revisor.rb:85: Changing @post.save to @post.save(validate: !@opts[:skip_validations]) makes every caller of revise! honor a skip-validations flag, allowing embed updates to skip length/spam validations that apply to ordinary edits — a silent widening of the accepted constraint that all post edits are validated

Stored XSS: `cook_method: raw_html` in app/models/post.rb:131-134 combined with app/models/topic_embed.rb:20 bypasses the entire sanitization pipeline on attacker-influenced RSS feed content, allowing persistent script execution via unsanitized content rendered with `raw` in app/views/embed/best.html.erb:20

Reflected/stored XSS via unescaped URL interpolation into HTML in app/models/topic_embed.rb:12 — user-supplied `embed_url` is interpolated into an HTML attribute/string with no escaping, allowing injected markup like `<svg onload=...>` to be stored in post body

Reflected XSS in app/views/layouts/embed.html.erb:10 — `request.referer` (client-controlled) interpolated raw into inline `<script>` JavaScript string context; `ensure_embeddable` host check does not prevent breaking out of the JS string literal

SSRF in app/models/topic_embed.rb:42 and app/jobs/scheduled/poll_feed.rb:29 — server-side fetch of attacker-influenced URL via open-uri follows redirects unrestricted with no re-validation, allowing redirection to internal hosts (e.g., 169.254.169.254) with content exfiltrated through the public embed page

postMessage origin check in app/assets/javascripts/embed.js:16 uses substring match (`indexOf(e.origin) === -1`) instead of equality, allowing origins containing the forum origin as a substring (e.g., example.com.evil.com) to pass the check

spec/jobs/poll_feed_spec.rb:34-37 — 'delegates to poll_feed' test mocks the method under test, leaving the entire real poll_feed implementation (link/id fallback, user.blank? branch, CGI.unescapeHTML on nil content) with zero coverage
CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub) raises NoMethodError on Atom entries where content is nil

spec/components/topic_retriever_spec.rb:30-42 — 'valid host' tests stub both retrieved_recently? and perform_retrieve, so the real throttle (redis setnx/expire), no_throttle staff bypass, and perform_retrieve body are never exercised

spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb:38-41 — 'Supports updating the post' test never verifies the content_sha1 state transition (update via update_column) nor that re-import with unchanged content does not create a revision

spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:46-51 — 'creates a topic view' test renders against a bare mocha mock, making response.should be_success a tautology that never validates the actual best.html.erb template rendering
spec/controllers/embed_controller_spec.rb:37-41 — TopicRetriever.expects(:new) has no with(...) constraint, so arguments passed by the controller (embed_url, no_throttle flag) are unverified

Migration creates topic_embeds with no foreign keys on topic_id/post_id and no dependent: :destroy cleanup, so deleting a topic/post leaves orphaned rows that wedge the PollFeed job — PostRevisor revises a deleted post or raises NoMethodError on nil, aborting the loop mid-way so later feed items never import, and retry: false swallows the failure
Orphaned topic_embeds rows permanently block re-importing the same embed_url due to the unique index on embed_url

add_column :posts, :cook_method, :integer, default: 1, null: false rewrites the entire posts table under an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on PostgreSQL, blocking all reads and writes with no disable_ddl_transaction!/multi-step strategy

force: true added to an already-shipped migration (create_table :top_topics) means a rollback-and-rerun will silently DROP and recreate the populated top_topics table, destroying computed topic stats with no backup step
create_table :top_topics ... force: true in a shipped migration changes its meaning for databases that already ran it, causing silent data loss on re-run
force: true on create_topic_embeds silently drops existing embed mapping rows in partial/rerun scenarios with no export

t.string :embed_url capped at 255 chars with a unique index causes TopicEmbed.create! to raise for longer article URLs inside the Topic.transaction, aborting the whole PollFeed run with retry: false, and since the transaction rolls back nothing is persisted so the job fails identically every hour with no repair path
